info.title: Health Triage Assistant API
info.description:
### Offline-First Health Triage Assistant API

Production-grade RESTful API serving clinical triage evaluation, emergency dispatch, health profile management, and PWA outbox sync.

**Key Architectural Highlights:**
- **Dual Intelligence**: Deterministic rule engine + optional Gemini AI enhancement
- **Multilingual**: BCP 47 language tagging (English `en`, Twi `tw`)
- **Clean Architecture**: Isolated domain models, services, and interface adapters
- **RFC 7807 Errors**: Structured problem details error payloads

post.summary: Evaluate symptoms against clinical decision tree
post.description: Passes patient symptom inputs through the deterministic clinical rule engine. Returns urgency level (RED/ORANGE/YELLOW/GREEN), primary action, and timeframe. Authentication is optional — anonymous triage is permitted. See /docs/RuleEngineDesign.md for full decision tree specification.

get.summary: Fetch the latest active clinical rule tree
get.description: Returns the full JSON decision tree structure for the currently active rule tree version. Used by the client-side offline rule engine to update its local cache. No authentication required — the rule tree is public data.
Returns a paginated list of past triage sessions for the authenticated user.
Returns the health profile for the currently authenticated user.

post.description: Logs an emergency dispatch event with GPS location linked to a triage session. Returns a pre-formatted SMS payload string for the client to send. See /docs/EmergencySystem.md for full protocol specification.
Idempotently ingests a batch of offline triage session records from the client-side IndexedDB outbox queue. Deduplicates by session UUID. See /docs/OfflineStrategy.md — Section 3 (Outbox Pattern).

The four canonical clinical urgency codes.

These must mirror app/domain/value_objects/urgency_level.py exactly.

UrgencyLevel.title: UrgencyLevel
UrgencyLevel.description:
Four-tier clinical urgency classification.

- RED: Life-threatening emergency. Immediate intervention required.
- ORANGE: Very urgent. Hospital evaluation within 60 minutes.
- YELLOW: Urgent. Clinic visit within 24 hours.
- GREEN: Non-urgent. Self-care guidance; routine appointment.
